summary: Controller can use an external PostgreSQL (15 managed; 15, 16, 17 external, with 16 and 17 needing external backups) through a credentials secret set on the controller spec; one instance can hold hub, controller and gateway databases with different names.
questions: Can automation controller on OpenShift use an external database?
Which PostgreSQL versions can controller use externally?
Can controller and hub share a PostgreSQL server?
